findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Order/Preorder/Finite.lean:89` defines `Set.Finite.exists_le_maximal (hs) (ha) : ∃ b, a ≤ b ∧ Maximal (· ∈ s) b`; lines 128–131 instead use `Set.exists_max_image`, cardinal comparison, and `Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le`.
findings.fix: Apply `Set.Finite.exists_le_maximal` to `{ρ | ρ ∈ K ∧ v ∉ ρ}` and the witness `⟨hσ, hv⟩`, then unfold `Maximal` to obtain the required equality property.
findings.issue: `exists_maximal_notMem_of_mem` rederives maximality by maximizing `Finset.card`, although Mathlib directly provides maximal elements of finite preorders.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Finset/Sum.lean:228` defines `Finset.sumEquiv` with `toFun s = (s.toLeft, s.toRight)` and inverse `disjSum`; lines 253–261 reconstruct exactly its injectivity via `toLeft_disjSum_toRight`.
findings.fix: Use `Finset.sumEquiv : Finset (α ⊕ β) ≃o Finset α × Finset β` to transport/subset the finite product set, eliminating `hinj` and its reconstruction proof.
findings.issue: `faces_finite_cone` manually proves injectivity of the left/right projection map instead of using Mathlib's existing equivalence.

summary: Two proofs reimplement existing Mathlib order/equivalence infrastructure and should be reduced to those APIs.
